data.why: Superdry opened its first store in Argentina three weeks ago, marking a fresh international market entry. For a retail CFO, launching in a new country brings a sudden influx of local suppliers, freight carriers, and store expenses that hit the accounts payable team.
data.angle: new store openings in foreign markets create a wave of new supplier and logistics invoices that need manual processing and approvals across entities

not_chosen.reason: Bad news: criminal conviction of co-founder.
Debt refinancing is a capital structure event rather than an operational trigger for back-office accounting workload.
A 12-month contract AP assistant posting reflects routine backfilling rather than a strategic business milestone.
Hiring a tax manager focuses on compliance and VAT advisory rather than core AP and invoice workflows.

data.subject: argentina store
data.body:
Hi Greg,

Superdry opened its first store in Argentina.

Expanding into a new country usually means taking on dozens of local suppliers, from freight to store fittings, each sending bills in different formats. Who is keying and matching those invoices today?

Mindbody processes 95%+ of invoices end to end with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
